findings.title: Medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
findings.evidence: README.md documents Bronze → Silver → Gold, and the pipeline scripts read bronze then write silver, validate silver, and write gold.
findings.reasoning: The repository follows Bronze -> Silver -> Gold with a middle-layer validation step before entering silver and a silver -> gold forecast step. There is no bronze-to-gold skip and no raw overwrite of bronze data in the transformation jobs.

findings.title: Raw source data not modified in place
findings.evidence: Treasury_Pipeline/01_IngestCashPositions.py reads bronze files and writes silver files rather than overwriting bronze.
findings.reasoning: No transformation or analysis step writes back over the same bronze/raw file it reads. The ingest script reads bronze and writes to silver, and the later scripts read silver and write validated silver or gold outputs.
